Whether the Los Angeles mayoral race was, in fact, flooded with fraudulent votes is besides the point. What matters is that there is the appearance of fraud, and people have lost trust in the elections. This, combined with the lack of safeguards to prevent or stop alleged fraud, is a problem. So, while you might think the mayoral race was the most legitimate election since Biden won in 2020, or you may not, Americans still deserve to have faith in their institutions. This is why Spencer Pratt said what needed to be said.
